---
title: "Components"
---

Most pages show how Askr styles native Quarto article components. The Cards
page documents one opt-in authoring pattern built from Quarto's native fenced
divs. Each page below focuses on one family or pattern.

## Already changed

- [Headings](components/headings.qmd). Level-two headings no longer draw
  Quarto's bottom rule. A divider is an explicit `---` instead.
- [Prose](components/prose.qmd). Article links, highlight, list markers,
  blockquotes, and the content divider.
- [Callouts](components/callouts.qmd). The five native types, their shell,
  icons, and disclosure chevron.
- [Cards](components/cards.qmd). A CSS-only nested fenced-div pattern with a
  real heading and one title link.
- [Code](components/code.qmd). Inline code, fenced blocks, and local overflow.
- [Tables](components/tables.qmd). Header and cell rules.
- [Mathematics](components/mathematics.qmd). Display math scrolls inside the
  measure.
- [References](components/references.qmd). In-text citations and the reference
  list.

## Still Quarto's own presentation

- [Figures and groups](components/figures.qmd). Columns, tabsets, diagrams,
  and an image from Embla. The groups stay Quarto's own
  presentation. The image uses Quarto's folded Source.
- [Saved notebook output](notebook-output.qmd). A real executed cell, separate
  from a fenced code block.

Chrome such as Areas, the Page List, and the centered measure is recorded on
the [Layout](gallery/layout.qmd) page.
